caption:
Stock market news | SEBI warns investors against fraudsters impersonating registered intermediaries

Fraudsters are impersonating SEBI-registered intermediaries on closed WhatsApp and Telegram groups. Group administrators use international mobile numbers and promise assured returns to lure investors into unauthorised trading platforms, where money is siphoned off.

Save this for later and send it to a friend who trades.

For information only. Not investment advice.

#StockMarketIndia #SEBI #InvestorAwareness #CyberFraud #TickerMarketIndia
